## Où j'en suis
At the end of the last session, the follow-up to merged #418 was implemented on tom/dashboard-keyboard: keyboard move/resize and a visible focus ring are in commit 8f1a2c7 and open PR #423; DashboardGrid/useGridKeyboard tests are green, dashboards_v2 is on for zest-grocers on staging only, no @visx dependencies remain, and the user ended the day there. (source: ses-db-4, d4-01, d4-05, d4-07, d4-09, d4-10)

- [en-cours] PR #423 ("Dashboards v2: keyboard move/resize + focus ring") is open and Priya's review was requested. (source: kestrel-analytics/platform#423, d4-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Await Priya's review on #423; then the user will flip the dashboards_v2 production flag himself for Zest on the morning of the 24th. (source: d4-05, d4-06, kestrel-analytics/platform#423)
- [essai-raté] Wrapping grid items with dnd-kit KeyboardSensor failed: ArrowRight moved by two columns, mouse drag fired two layout changes, because dnd-kit and react-grid-layout handled the same events; avoiding that would mean rewriting the grid. (source: d4-02)
- [décision] Merge #418 with squash; Priya's two follow-ups go to a follow-up PR. (source: c3-05, kestrel-analytics/platform#418, src-pr418)
- [décision] Use an own keyboard handler on top of the layout state, with no dnd-kit. (source: d4-04, 8f1a2c7)
- [décision] Keep recharts and close the visx migration PR #401. (source: c3-03, kestrel-analytics/platform#401, src-pr401)
- [décision] dashboards_v2 stays limited to the Zest workspace for the demo; production is left to the user on the morning of the 24th, and legacy dashboards stay available behind the flag until January with nothing removed now. (source: b2-04, d4-06)
